narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to inform the audience about a software solution called PawSense designed to prevent pet cats from accidentally typing or causing system damage when stepping on computer keyboards. It uses a blend of humor, relatable cat footage, and educational storytelling to engage viewers.
